    • basePath

      public ConsoleFreemarkerMixin.Builder basePath(String value)
      Sets the classpath base path under which template resources are resolved.

      Defaults to "/". A typical configured value is "/templates/" — the same Spring-Boot-compatible layout convention the sibling JSP / Thymeleaf / Mustache bridges use.

      Covariantly narrowed to this Builder so a fluent chain can mix inherited setters (e.g. basePath(String)) with the console-specific chromeTemplate(String) / registerToolkitPack(ToolkitPack) in any order.

      Specified by:
      basePath in interface ViewMixinBuilder<FreemarkerMixin.Builder>
      Overrides:
      basePath in class FreemarkerMixin.Builder
      Parameters:
      value - The base path. null or blank values reset to the default FreemarkerMixin.DEFAULT_BASE_PATH.
      Returns:
      This object.

    • requirePacks

      public ConsoleFreemarkerMixin.Builder requirePacks(String... names)
      Opts in to the startup WebJar check: the named packs (for example "charts") are expanded through dependsOn and every WebJar they reach is probed when the mixin is built, so a missing org.webjars.npm:echarts fails at startup (E-70) instead of on the first chart page. An app pack registered with registerToolkitPack(ToolkitPack) that depends on "echarts" opts in too.
      Parameters:
      names - Registered pack names.
      Returns:
      This object.

    • cardType

      public ConsoleFreemarkerMixin.Builder cardType(CardTypeHandler handler)
      Registers a server-side card type handler for this mixin's <@card> directive, on top of CardTypeRegistry.standard().

      Most custom cards need only a JS handler; register a CardTypeHandler here when the server must validate or enrich the body. To also load toolkit packs for the type, use cardRequires(String, String...).

      Parameters:
      handler - The handler. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      This object.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - E-21 bad type name; E-22 reserved type; E-20 already registered.

    • devMode

      public ConsoleFreemarkerMixin.Builder devMode(boolean value)
      Validates every page contract against juneau-page.schema.json when <@console> closes, and fails the render with E-14 on any finding.

      Defaults to the juneau.console.devMode system property. Intended for development and tests; it parses and validates the contract on every render.

      Example:

      @Bean public FreemarkerMixin freemarker() { return ConsoleFreemarkerMixin.create().devMode(true).basePath("/templates/").build(); }

      Parameters:
      value - Whether to validate.
      Returns:
      This object.

    • adopterAssets

      public ConsoleFreemarkerMixin.Builder adopterAssets(ClassLoader loader, String resourceRoot)
      Enables the assetUrl(path) template function that versions the adopter's own static assets.

      assetUrl('/js/app.js') returns /js/app.js?v=<crc32 of the bundled bytes>, where the bytes are read once (and the token cached) from resourceRoot + path on loader. This is the adopter-side counterpart of Juneau's own viewAssetUrl/consoleJsUrl/chromeCssUrl/themeAssetUrl cache-busters, for files the servlet container's static handler serves. A path with a query string, a non-root-absolute path (e.g. an external URL), or a path naming no bundled resource is returned unchanged (the last also logs a warning in dev mode). The URL path itself is never rewritten, so any context-path prefix must be added by the template.

      Example:

      @Bean public FreemarkerMixin freemarker() { return ConsoleFreemarkerMixin.create() .basePath("/templates/") .adopterAssets(getClass().getClassLoader(), "static") // /js/app.js -> classpath static/js/app.js .build(); }

      <script src="${assetUrl('/js/app.js')}"></script>

      Parameters:
      loader - The class loader that holds the assets. Must not be null.
      resourceRoot - The classpath directory the URL paths are relative to (e.g. "static"); a leading and trailing slash are optional. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      This object.
